variants.name: 로즈 래커 스크립트
variants.direction: DIRECTION A: Inspired by the reference's expertly flowing glossy sculptural script and sophisticated thick-to-thin letter rhythm. Create an exquisite rose-lacquer custom PlanCraft signature: deep burgundy-rose for Plan, warmer rose for Craft with coherent soft highlight gradients. Substantial smooth connected strokes, generous uppercase P and C, a carefully restrained baseline sweep, shallow extruded burgundy sides, pinpoint warm ivory edge highlights. Elegant calligraphic momentum with highly legible lowercase. The polished enamel light should make the shape feel crafted and dimensional, not fake chrome or a cheap shiny sticker. No long underlines, no extra sparkle icons. Treat every character as a finished piece of custom sculptural lettering.
variants.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Deliver a professional finished IMAGE WORDMARK, not a font specimen. Exact and ONLY text: "PlanCraft" (P l a n C r a f t), exactly once and clearly readable. An AI-assisted software planning and creative workshop brand.
REFERENCE ROLES: Image 1 is the existing PlanCraft app icon, for identity and color harmony ONLY. Do NOT redraw or include the icon, it will be placed beside the lettering unchanged in HTML. Image 2 is a real wordmark from a sibling site in the user's own LifeCraft ecosystem, used as a STYLE / LEVEL-OF-FINISH reference. Make original PlanCraft lettering which belongs to that same level of designed identity; don't reproduce the reference's name, exact glyphs or icon.
This user has rejected stock fonts and flat black/rose lettering: the new mark needs intentional letter construction, lighting, material and a resolved recognizable logo silhouette. A fully produced brand asset, rich but controlled, beautifully spaced and suitable at 160px wide in a website header.
PlanCraft palette must remain rose #D4547A, deep rose #B8405F, warm cream #FBF9F6, ivory highlights, darker burgundy for depth. Do not introduce the reference's blue, cyan, violet, yellow or green color scheme.
OUTPUT: single isolated horizontal wordmark, TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND with real alpha, wide roughly 3:1 canvas, centered with generous clear space so no flourish is cut off. Strong readable body strokes. No artboard, no rectangular backdrop, no labels A/B/C/D, no slogan, no other words, no fake UI, no mockup objects, no watermarks, no separate standalone icon. Material shading and dimensional edges are explicitly wanted.

variants.name: 크림 북바인딩
variants.direction: DIRECTION B: Inspired by the reference's tactile cream letters, layered outline, book-like unity and confident polished family-friendly identity. Original custom PlanCraft wordmark: warm ivory/cream face on Plan, soft rose face on Craft; a beautifully controlled deep burgundy outer contour and thin warm cream keyline unify the whole word. Soft sculpted letter bevels, subtle warm depth, gently rounded serif-like terminals, large capital P and C, sculpted lowercase, sturdy readable counters. A subtle short layered ivory paper/book edge sits just beneath the central letter baseline and joins the lettering into ONE compact lockup; a tiny rose bookmark fold integrated below the C may be used. This is a sophisticated illustrated book/workshop nameplate, not an extra open-book icon, not a badge rectangle. Rich dimensional detail but clean enough for a header.

variants.name: 새틴 메이커
variants.direction: DIRECTION C: Inspired by the reference's purpose-built soft 3D letters and controlled ed-tech brand finish. Create distinct ORIGINAL PlanCraft custom rounded block lettering with beautifully smooth satin-resin faces and precise soft chamfered edges. Plan in rich dark rose, Craft in lighter muted rose with ivory specular edge glints; shallow darker burgundy extrusion, viewed almost straight-on so reading is effortless. Strong geometric but friendly letter bodies, distinctive P counter with a subtly folded-page notch, open C, balanced a/r/f/t, slight organic shaping rather than a stock rounded font. No cartoon balloon swelling, no sharp toy plastic reflections, no floating pen/book/sparkle, no separate pictograms. Visual craft should be evident in the letter surfaces, depth, spacing and custom cuts.

variants.name: 로즈우드 스튜디오
variants.direction: DIRECTION D: Inspired by the reference's economical, bespoke, warm architectural wordmark, preserve its mature design restraint while building a DIFFERENT PlanCraft identity. Lowercase forms with uppercase P/C, thick softly squared strokes, sculpted bowls and terminals, consistent wide counters and carefully balanced optical kerning. Warm dark burgundy/rosewood Plan, muted dusty-rose Craft. Add very shallow bas-relief edges and quiet upper-left warm highlights, like finely cut rosewood coated in matte enamel; the depth is subtle and precise, NOT glossy and NOT a distressed wooden texture. One clever page-shaped negative-space cut in P or C, integrated into the actual letter. Crisp readable compact silhouette. This option should feel like a refined creative software brand, unlike script and illustrated nameplate options. No serifs, no stock-font appearance, no metallic embellishment.
